compose_subtitle: Write it once, pick the channels, then publish it now or schedule it.

match.countPlural=one: Up to {count} image: JPEG, PNG or WebP, at most {max} each.
match.countPlural=*: Up to {count} images: JPEG, PNG or WebP, at most {max} each.

compose_image_bad_type: {name}: only JPEG, PNG and WebP images can be added.

match.countPlural=one: A post can have at most {count} image.
match.countPlural=*: A post can have at most {count} images.

match.countPlural=one: Describe the image for people who can't see it. Up to {count} character.
match.countPlural=*: Describe the image for people who can't see it. Up to {count} characters.

compose_ai_generated_hint: Instagram marks it as made with AI. The other networks have no such label.
compose_video_hint: Or one MP4, QuickTime or WebM video up to {max}.
compose_video_bad_type: {name}: only MP4, QuickTime and WebM videos can be added.
compose_video_limit: A post can have only one video.
compose_media_exclusive: A post can have images or one video, not both.
compose_video_ai_marked: This video is marked as AI-generated in this workspace, and the label can't be removed.
compose_channel_video_unsupported: Video isn't supported on this network yet.
compose_channel_needs_image: Needs an image or a video.
compose_channel_image_too_large: An image is larger than the {max} this network accepts.
compose_channel_image_type: This network doesn't accept the format of an attached image.

match.countPlural=one: This network accepts at most {count} image.
match.countPlural=*: This network accepts at most {count} images.

compose_channel_unsupported: Posting to this network isn't supported yet.
compose_error_empty: Write some text or add an image.
compose_error_ai_marked: Image {position} is already marked as AI-generated in this workspace, and the mark can't be removed yet. Tick “Image {position} is AI-generated” to post it, or use a different image.
compose_error_fix: The post can't go out yet. Fix the following and try again:
compose_error_post_changed: This post changed after you opened it. Reload it to see the latest version; your edits here will be lost.
compose_error_now_draft: The post is now a draft. Saving again continues from there.
compose_edit_queue_note: Saving takes the next free slots in each channel's queue.
compose_edit_review_note: Saving changed content withdraws the open approval request.
compose_refused_channel_unavailable: This post can't be edited because one of its channels isn't available.
compose_refused_channel_twice: This post can't be edited because it goes to the same channel twice.
compose_refused_reply_media: This post can't be edited because a reply or comment has media.
compose_refused_mixed_media: This post can't be edited because it has images next to a video.
compose_refused_many_videos: This post can't be edited because it has more than one video.
compose_refused_repeated_media: This post can't be edited because it uses the same media twice.
compose_refused_media_unavailable: This post can't be edited because some of its media isn't available.
compose_refused_item_order: This post can't be edited because its items are in an order the composer can't show.
compose_edit_series_note: The series schedules this draft at that time.
compose_refused_publish_type: This post can't be edited because its publish type isn't the one the composer would choose.
compose_refused_rich_content: This post can't be edited because its text has formatting the composer can't show.
compose_inherits: Uses the content from All channels.
compose_use_default: Use the content from All channels
compose_main_only: {channel} will publish the main post only.
compose_error_empty_channel: Write some text or add an image for {channel}.
compose_error_approval_required: This post needs an approval before it can be scheduled.
compose_edit_series_skip: Keeping this as a draft skips this occurrence of the series.
compose_edit_canceled_note: Canceled on: {channels}. Saving a change removes these from the post; tick one to publish to it again.
compose_error_channel_gone: This post can't be saved because a channel it goes to is no longer available: {channels}.
compose_refused_part_live: This post can't be edited because a canceled destination is already live in part.
compose_error_tags: The post was saved, but its tags weren't. Saving again tries once more.
compose_error_tags_opened: The tags weren't saved, so nothing else in this save changed. Saving again tries once more.
compose_error_tags_unscheduled: The post was saved as a draft, but its tags weren't, so it isn't scheduled yet. Saving again finishes it.
